description: Python script for downloading and repacking GitHub archive tarballs, including handling of commit timestamps, hash verification, and submodule checks.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Context manager for directory preparation, cleanup, and tarball operations.

classes.name: GitHubCommitTsCache
classes.description: Cache for storing and retrieving GitHub commit timestamps to avoid redundant API calls.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubTarball
classes.description: Handles downloading, verifying, and repacking GitHub archive tarballs, including commit timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, initializes download process with provided arguments.

methods.name: _has_submodule
methods.description: Checks if the directory contains a submodule by looking for a non-empty .gitmodules file.

methods.name: _init_owner_repo
methods.description: Extracts owner and repository name from the GitHub URL.

methods.name: _init_hasher
methods.description: Initializes hash object based on expected hash length (SHA256 or MD5).

methods.name: _hash_check
methods.description: Verifies the downloaded tarball's hash matches the expected hash.

methods.name: _init_commit_ts
methods.description: Fetches and caches the commit timestamp from GitHub API.

methods.name: _init_commit_ts_remote_get
methods.description: Makes a remote API request to fetch commit date and converts it to epoch time.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Downloads the tarball of the specified version from GitHub.

methods.name: _make_repo_url_path
methods.description: Constructs GitHub API URL paths for repository data.

methods.name: _make_request
methods.description: Performs an HTTPS request to the GitHub API endpoint.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a DownloadGitHubError with a message.
